_readme: Experience section. `end: null` marks the current role (dates render in accent with `presentLabel`). Each role can carry a `photos` array rendered as a small strip under its bullets: {src, alt, caption, aspect}. `src` is a path under ./public, and the loader drops any photo whose file is missing, so the placeholders below stay invisible until you add the file at that exact path. Use aspect "4/3" for normal photos, "16/9" for wide shots and "9/16" for phone photos.

items.title: Lead IT Systems Developer
bullets: Promoted to Lead IT within the first year; own six commercial systems end to end across architecture, development, testing, CI/CD and production operations.
Built TypeScript microservices over gRPC and RabbitMQ with per-service PostgreSQL and MongoDB, Redis caching, and WebSocket delivery fanned out across gateway instances.
Own CI/CD for the product suite with automated tests, SAST, SCA, container and secret scanning, and signed containerized deploys; run Prometheus and Grafana monitoring and resolve live incidents.
